name: 彭瑞玟
objective:
本課程以「中世紀到工業革命」為主軸：將探索中世紀、文藝復興、啟蒙時代與工業革命期間，人類社會如何在科技、經濟與文化變遷下，發展新的生活型態與設計方式。課程內容包括中世紀的宗教建築與工藝技術、文藝復興時期的美學與人文思想對設計的影響、啟蒙時代的科技發展，以及工業革命帶來的大規模生產與都市化現象。學生將分析從手工製作到機械生產的轉變如何影響產品設計、家具設計與建築風格，並探討此時期的設計理念如何延續至今日。
This course centers on the theme "From the Middle Ages to the Industrial Revolution," exploring how human societies adapted their lifestyles and design approaches in response to technological, economic, and cultural transformations during the Middle Ages, the Renaissance, the Enlightenment, and the Industrial Revolution. Course topics include religious architecture and craftsmanship in the Middle Ages, the influence of aesthetics and humanist thought on Renaissance design, technological advancements of the Enlightenment, and the large-scale production and urbanization brought by the Industrial Revolution. Students will analyze how the transition from handcrafted to mechanized production impacted product design, furniture design, and architectural styles, as well as how design concepts from this period continue to influence the present day.
schedule:
W01 文藝復興的設計與空間美學
W02–03 印刷術與書籍設計
W04–05 巴洛克與洛可可的器物與建築
W06 啟蒙思想與家具秩序化設計
W07–08 殖民貿易下的跨文化設計（瓷、茶、紡織）
W09 中期報告
W10–11 中國明清物質文化與日常生活
W12–13 日本江戶時期與浮世繪生活
W14 城市生活的變遷：咖啡館、公共設施
W15–16 工業革命前的技術進步
W17 學生專題報告
W18 期末總結
